ideas.name: Aggregate Dividend Payment Pressure
ideas.claim: Higher aggregate dividend payments are associated with higher same-day value-weighted market returns.
ideas.quote: We find that when daily dividend payouts are higher, daily value-weighted market returns are significantly higher.
ideas.mechanism: Dividend payments and subsequent reinvestment create market-wide buying pressure.
ideas.claimed_result: A one-standard-deviation increase in payout is associated with 3.2 basis points higher daily returns.

ideas.name: Predicted Dividend Month Premium
ideas.claim: Companies have positive abnormal returns during months when they are predicted to issue a dividend.
ideas.quote: We find an asset pricing anomaly whereby companies have positive abnormal returns in months when they are predicted to issue a dividend.

rules.filters: Companies predicted to issue a dividend in the month; prediction method not stated in the opened abstract.

ideas.claimed_result: Positive abnormal returns in predicted dividend months relative to other companies and dividend-paying companies without a predicted dividend that month.
